atoms.a: Mike's little brother Theo is quite spoiled. He always asks for new toys and gets upset when his parents say no. Mike, however, is patient and sensible. He tries to help his parents and shares his things with his brother.

Yesterday, Sheila's friends wanted her to gossip about a classmate who had made a mistake in class. Sheila didn't want to gossip about or judge her classmate, but she was worried that her friends wouldn't understand why she refused to join in.

Ben's friends often ask him to skip class with them, and sometimes they also gossip about their teacher. Ben doesn't really want to join in, but he feels pressured to fit in with the group... When Ben finally tells his friends that he disapproves of skipping class and gossiping, they stop talking to him for a few days... Then the new student, whose name is Evan, tells him he really admires how confident Ben is, and the two quickly become friends.
b: --Evan, the new student, thinks that Ben is selfish.
++Ben's friends want him to skip class.
++Ben feels pressured to fit in with the group.

atoms.text: Schreibe die fehlenden Wörter in die Lücken.

instruction.sound: Good morning, listeners! An animal shelter called “Helping Hands”, which opened last year near the city park, is looking for volunteers. They need people who are patient, trustworthy and sensible. You don't need experience, just a love for animals! Volunteers who can come on Saturday or Sunday are especially needed. The manager, whose name is Sylvia Johnson, says the shelter has fifteen animals that need your help. She's looking for people who are dedicated and can help at least two hours per week.
